core-assault.summary: An unengaged unit that Advanced this turn can shoot using only its [ASSAULT] weapons. After shooting, it cannot start an Action until the end of the phase.
core-assault.definition: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can use Assault Shooting. Assault Shooting is available when the unit is unengaged, made an Advance move this turn and has one or more [ASSAULT] weapons. The unit shoots normally, but only [ASSAULT] weapons can be selected. After it shoots, the unit cannot start an Action until the end of the phase.

core-blast.summary: When gathering attack dice, add 1 attack die for every full 5 models in the target unit. [BLAST X] adds X attack dice instead.
core-blast.definition: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add 1 attack die for every full 5 models that were in the target unit during the Select Targets step. For [BLAST X], add X attack dice for every full 5 models instead. Example: [BLAST 2] against a 12-model unit adds 4 attack dice.

core-cleave.summary: When gathering attack dice, if all of this weapon's attacks target one unit, add X attack dice for every full 5 models in that unit.
core-cleave.definition: [CLEAVE] always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for this weapon, if you selected only one target for all of the weapon's attacks, add X attack dice for every full 5 models that were in the target unit during the Select Targets step. Example: [CLEAVE 1] with A 3 against a 16-model unit adds 3 attack dice, for a total of 6.
